ideas.pitch: A localized multi-language emergency triage and rPPG vital-signs scanner built for regional hospitals.
ideas.title: MediTriage Amritsar
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven pattern from mediscan-ai of clinical-grade AI and live camera vital sign extraction which dazzles offline hackathon panels.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first agent running locally on Mac/PC that detects and intercepts social engineering phone scams targeting the elderly in Punjabi and English.
ideas.title: ElderShield Voice Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact architecture and social impact focus of gosim-zai-hack-winner, addressing a deeply relatable consumer protection angle.

ideas.pitch: A GPS-enabled civic issue reporter with an automated municipal routing dashboard and AI local business promoter.
ideas.title: CivicPatrol Punjab
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the real-world utility and live council dashboard pattern that successfully won the Chatswood AI hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A rapid graph-based transaction anomaly risk-detection dashboard for regional cooperative banks.
ideas.title: RiskGraph AML Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies high-value enterprise graph intelligence and explainable risk scores, echoing the winning strategy of Bito.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered garbage classification prototype using computer vision with a simulated Arduino/TinkerCAD hardware bridge.
ideas.title: EcoSort Robotics Sim
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines software vision with hardware automation storytelling, directly matching the TechnoMorph Hackathon runner-up profile.
